sequential_summaries: Exactly the existing 13 channel summaries; 26 new features and 51 unchanged old ABCD features for every variant.

candidates.hypothesis: ARCH1 forecast evidence is a monotone compression of lagged clipped energy when alpha is positive. Test whether robust energy compression or forecasting alignment accounts for the gain.
candidates.change: Retain raw energy and replace log ARCH variance forecast with current log1p(energy/H_variance); historical 99th-percentile clipping=False.
candidates.expected_effect: Compress rare large residuals before sequential aggregation; current alignment may improve response without the one-point forecasting lag.
candidates.risks: Log energy changes the null distribution and can lose scale sensitivity. These are prospective mechanism tests motivated by prior DEV results, with the original screen and promotion gates retained.
